{{Quote|I looked up from my research and found myself looking at Lutris Lake, and I don't have a window. My whole wall was gone by the time I could tell anyone.|Zobyteeg|<ref name="HNNews" />}}
'''Zobyteeg''' was an individual who served as a [[General Council Assistant]] in the locale [[Lutris]] on the<ref name="HNNews" /> [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]].<ref name="HNNews" /> Shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="CSWE Razelfiin">{{CSWECite|III|84|Razelfiin}}</ref> which began in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> Zobyteeg was working at the [[Tynna Central Government Building]]<ref name="HNNews" /> when it was destroyed by [[Stone mite/Legends|stone mites]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|271|Tynna}}</ref> The first to alert [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|local security]], he was later interviewed about the event by [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]], telling the [[Journalist/Legends|interviewer]] that he realized something was wrong when he was afforded a clear view of [[Lutris Lake]] despite the fact that his office did not possess a [[Window/Legends|window]].<ref name="HNNews" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zobyteeg appeared in the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]] in the [[in-universe]] issue [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 53|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #53'']], published<ref name="HNNews" /> on [[April 25]], [[2002]]<ref name="HNN53 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6586618|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=Mastadge|date=2002-04-25|time=5:54 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200305125429/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-13}}</ref> and written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]].<ref name="HNN Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref>
